chunks: Then they are taken to God, their real lord and master. His indeed is the judgement; and He is swift at reckoning.
ai.seo_question: Who holds the final judgment and is swift at reckoning?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-An'am underscores the absolute sovereignty of Allah as the ultimate 'Master' (Mawla) to whom all souls return after death. It highlights the immediacy of divine retribution, reinforcing the concept that God’s accounting is not only exclusive to Him but also swift, serving as a profound reminder of accountability in the Hereafter.
